dedupe_keys.name: pedgo traffgo ht microscopic pedestrian evacuation simulation for buildings and ships

description: PedGo is a commercial program from TraffGo HT for simulating how people evacuate buildings and ships. It is a microscopic model: every person is represented and moves and decides individually on a grid, following methods developed in the German research project BYPASS. The company stresses speed, so that users can run many randomised evacuations and analyse the spread of evacuation times, not a single run, as ship evacuation rules require; a sister product, AENEAS, targets ships. Results can be replayed in 3D with the free PedView viewer. The manual, a tutorial with project files, a price list, publications and validation material are free to download from the company site, while the software itself is available under a paid licence, with a demo on request. Caveats: the model is proprietary, prices are on a price list, not the page, and validation evidence is supplied by the vendor. Coverage is general, for any building or ship geometry. Simulation uses: agent-based evacuation studies for public buildings, stations and ships, and comparison with other egress models in emergency planning. Related records: the Fire Model Survey egress list (data-fire-model-survey-egress-models) describes many of the models PedGo is compared against.
